story_title: Lina and Adams and Milo's Birthday Surprise
lesson: Learn birthday party words in English!
title: Milo's Birthday Surprise 🎂🎈 | Learn Party Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Today is Milo the cat's birthday! Lina and Adams plan a big surprise party. 🎂🎈🎁
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: birthday, surprise, balloon, gift, cake, candle and party. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🎉 birthday — عيد ميلاد — anniversaire
😲 surprise — مفاجأة — surprise
🎈 balloon — بالون — ballon de baudruche
🎁 gift — هدية — cadeau
🎂 cake — كعكة — gâteau
🕯️ candle — شمعة — bougie
🥳 party — حفلة — fête

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: sing Happy Birthday together and practise the new words! Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم كلمات عيد الميلاد.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre les mots de l'anniversaire.

lines.text: Lina and Adams are whispering in the kitchen. Shh!
Adams, do you know what day it is today?
Yes! It is Milo's birthday! He is two years old today.
A birthday is the day when we were born. Every year, we celebrate it.
Can you say it with me? Birthday!
Let's make a surprise for Milo!
Yes! But Milo must not know. It is a secret.
A surprise is something nice that you don't know is coming. Wow!
Say it with me: surprise!
Where is Milo? He is sleeping in the bedroom. Good!
Lina and Adams go into the garden to get ready.
I will blow up the balloons. Whoo, whoo, whoo!
One pink balloon, two pink balloons! They are so big!
A balloon is a soft toy filled with air. It can float up high.
Can you say it? Balloon!
Pop! Oh no, one balloon popped! Adams laughs. Let's make another one.
I have a gift for Milo. It is in this purple box.
What is inside? Tell me, tell me!
It is a new soft ball! Milo loves to play with balls.
A gift is something we give to someone, to make them happy.
Say it with me: gift!
Next, Lina and Adams make something sweet with Mom.
We need a cake! A pink birthday cake.
Mix, mix, mix. Bake, bake, bake. Now it is ready!
A cake is a sweet food we eat at parties.
Can you say it? Cake!
And for Milo, there is a little fish treat. Cats don't eat cake!
We need candles on the cake. How many?
Milo is two years old. But I put three candles, one for good luck!
A candle has a little flame on top. It gives light.
Only grown-ups light the candles, to be safe.
Say it with me: candle!
Everything is ready. Milo wakes up and walks into the garden.
One, two, three...
Surprise! Happy birthday, Milo!
Milo is so surprised! Meow, meow, meow! He jumps with joy.
A party is when friends and family get together to have fun.
Can you say it? Party!
Lina and Adams sing a song for Milo.
Happy birthday to you, happy birthday, dear Milo!
Milo opens his gift. A new ball! He plays and plays.
This is the best birthday party ever!
The sun goes down. What a happy day for Milo.
At night, Milo is sleepy. He curls up on the bed.
Today was Milo's birthday. We made a surprise.
We had balloons, a gift, a cake with candles, and a big party!
Happy birthday, Milo. We love you.
Purr, purr. Good night, Milo. Good night, friends.
